name: openspec-dashboard
description: Local-first Kanban across all OpenSpec repositories on this machine

scripts.dev: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun run src/server/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun build --compile src/server/index.ts --outfile dist/openspec-dashboard && rm -f .*.bun-build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
